keyPoints.en: 1826: Penang, Melaka and Singapore were united as the Straits Settlements.
keyPoints.bm: 1826: Pulau Pinang, Melaka dan Singapura disatukan sebagai Negeri-negeri Selat.

keyPoints.en: Reason: easier and cheaper to administer three ports together.
keyPoints.bm: Sebab: lebih mudah dan murah mentadbir tiga pelabuhan bersama.

keyPoints.en: Capital: Penang first, then Singapore from 1832.
keyPoints.bm: Pusat pentadbiran: Pulau Pinang dahulu, kemudian Singapura mulai 1832.

keyPoints.en: Governor at the head; Resident Councillors in each settlement.
keyPoints.bm: Gabenor sebagai ketua; Residen Konsilor di setiap negeri.

keyPoints.en: 1867: became a Crown Colony under the Colonial Office in London (traders were unhappy with rule from India).
keyPoints.bm: 1867: menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota di bawah Pejabat Tanah Jajahan di London (pedagang tidak puas hati dengan pemerintahan dari India).

keyPoints.en: Free ports drew Chinese and Indian immigrants, creating a multi-ethnic society.
keyPoints.bm: Pelabuhan bebas menarik imigran Cina dan India, membentuk masyarakat berbilang kaum.
